core_categories: Medical Devices; Personal Care & Wellness; Home Healthcare / DME
specialty_focus: Invacare Europe manufactures and distributes medical devices for home and long-term care. They focus on mobility equipment and post-acute care products that help people with reduced movement maintain comfortable, safe, and active lifestyles. Invacare Product Categories Manual & Power Wheelchairs: Active, passive, and children’s manual chairs (including the Küschall brand), plus motorized chairs, mobility scooters, and power add-ons (Alber).
key_brands: Invacare's Alber, Küschall, Action, Rea, Aviva
